items.title: A Confidence-Aware Multimodal Fusion Framework for Industrial Human-Robot Collaboration
items.abstract: A confidence-aware multimodal fusion framework (CAMF) is proposed to realize reliable human intention prediction for industrial human-robot collaboration. This framework fuses four heterogeneous modalities including object 6D pose, gaze, skeletal motion and IMU-based hand motion. It embeds a confidence-trend-driven dynamic fusion mechanism into BiLSTM to adaptively balance bidirectional temporal features according to real-time modality reliability. A confidence-guided balanced learning strategy combined with a confidence freezing mechanism is further adopted to adjust network gradients dynamically, suppress noise from low-quality modalities and mitigate cross-modal learning bias. A physical platform based on the UR3 collaborative robot is built for experimental validation. Comparative results show that the proposed method reaches an intention recognition accuracy of 91.86% and outperforms existing multimodal fusion approaches in overall performance and stability. It also maintains satisfactory accuracy under low light and partial occlusion interference. In practical assembly tasks, the framework enables proactive and stable human-robot cooperation with strong environmental adaptability.

items.llm_tldr_en: Multimodal signals in industrial collaboration vary in reliability; CAMF embeds confidence-trend-driven dynamic fusion into BiLSTM with balanced learning to suppress noisy modalities and cross-modal bias.
items.llm_tldr_cn: 工业人机协作中多模态信号质量参差不齐，低质量模态噪声与跨模态学习偏差会削弱人体意图预测的可靠性。本文提出置信度感知多模态融合框架CAMF，融合物体六自由度位姿、注视、骨骼运动与IMU手部运动四种模态，将置信度趋势驱动的动态融合机制嵌入BiLSTM，并配合置信度引导的平衡学习与冻结机制动态调节梯度。基于UR3协作机器人的实验表明该方法能有效抑制噪声、缓解跨模态偏差，实现可靠意图预测。
